scope: Adaptive playable next action where affinity readiness is unknown; no bounded completion forecast
eligibility: guarded positive date or observed offered interaction
free slot and all entity/story guards satisfied

preInteractionObservation.required: Inspect whether the game currently offers a rank-up event or an ordinary meeting
preInteractionObservation.unknownBranchPolicy: Offer an observation checkpoint without asserting rankDelta=0 or rankDelta=1
preInteractionObservation.observationOnlyCaution: No consumptive interaction or slot spend until the player actually chooses it; no invented in-game Chinese prompt

branches.policy: Use existing rank event with observed/declared answer path and reconcile completed outcome

branches.effect: preserve known lower bound but do not increment it by an invented amount; exact affinity becomes unknown; record observed readiness for next meeting

stopWhen: no guarded opportunity before planning horizon
player changes goal or declines action
adaptiveRepeatPolicy.recommendedUiAction: 前往会面，确认是否可升阶
adaptiveRepeatPolicy.postMeetingUiAction: 会面后确认下次能否升阶

constraints: A qualitative positive gain does not establish a numeric lower bound in the model units
Do not assume one ordinary meeting always establishes readiness
Observing readiness false is valid only at the observed current rank and point in time; later affinity actions invalidate that observation
Stat base-gain lower bounds do not establish ordinary affinity gain bounds
